description:
nhentai.to, a mirror that still serves the OLD (circa 2018) nhentai.net markup: #bigcontainer > #cover with a plain (no lazy attributes on the cover), #info > h1 holding the FULL bracketed title as one text node (no before/pretty/after spans, so the title rule has to be applied), h2 with the Japanese title, section#tags with .tag-container rows whose a.tag carries the name as a bare text node followed by span.count in parentheses "(98,321)", hrefs without a trailing slash (/tag/big-breasts), and the page count and date OUTSIDE the rows as "
22 pages
" and "
Uploaded …
". og:title is the full bracketed title too. Noise: nav that links popular tags directly (/tag/big-breasts, /tag/ahegao, /language/english), a mirror disclaimer, JuicyAds zones, thumbnails with data-src and a RELATIVE placeholder src (/img/blank.gif, not a data: URI), "More Like This" with five Quill Bwie galleries (one by the same circle), server-rendered comments with "Parody:" and an artist name in the text, and a footer linking /tag/full-color, /tag/netorare, /language/japanese, /language/chinese. Unsure: nhentai.to's exact CDN host (I recall cdn.dogehls.xyz), whether its cover is lazy-loaded, and whether it has its own comment system (reconstructed in old nhentai comment markup).
